title: Valid JSON did not ensure the preferred next action
subtitle: Two unresolved patterns in the saved-state replay · five states per case type
caveats: Twenty selected development states; five per case type. Descriptive rubric scores, not live recovery rates or evidence of a general regression.
Only the two fact arms match fact availability and near-exact length. Unlisted actions require review; they are not necessarily incorrect.
caption: No arm selected the preferred database-lock diagnostic in these five saved states. Successful-control preferred scores were 5/5, 4/5, 4/5 and 3/5 across the four arms. These are descriptive counts from five selected development states, not evidence of a general regression. Filled dots mean preferred actions; open dots include other rubric outcomes, not necessarily incorrect actions.
